senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; נָסַךְ) [anointed,] viceroy, prince (contradist. to מֶלֶךְ).
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20:4">Num. R. s. 20</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 22:4">Num. XXII, 4</cite>) <he>והלא מתחלה נ׳ היה וכ׳</he> but was he not originally a viceroy?… But when Sihon was slain, they appointed him king in his place; Yalk. ib. 765.
